meta.applies_to: Trianglz - Android M3 x Design System and every new Android DS built from Android_Design_System_Skill

color.rule: State layers = the role color at the state opacity. Figma variables cannot alias with alpha, so they are derived tokens regenerated by tools/recolor.py (see recolor.derived_tokens).

spacing.rule: the Trianglz file has no spacing variables yet; new builds must add them

typography.font: Google Sans Flex in the reference (Roboto Flex default for new builds; confirm licensing)
typography.value_format: [size sp, line height sp, tracking] for large, medium, small

icons.set: Material Symbols (one style: Rounded or Outlined), weight 400, grade 0, optical size 24
icons.naming: snake_case as in Google Fonts; filled versions end in _filled

components.naming: M3 public names; private parts start with .Building Blocks/
components.anatomy: container > State-layer > content; focus indicator from Utilities
components.bound: fills, strokes, padding/gap, radius (Shape), text and effect styles: 100% local

build_order: Schemes (Light/Dark + contrast modes) and state layers
Text styles and Elevation effect styles

recolor.principle: A color change edits only Palette tones. Schemes alias Palettes, so every component follows; derived tokens (state layers, surface tints) are recomputed from their role color.

generation.curve: each tone keeps its exact CIELAB L* (M3 tone = L*); hue and chroma follow the new key color with the captured chroma ratio per tone; for exact Material output you may instead generate the palette with Material Theme Builder / Material Color Utilities and paste it through the same script

steps: Find the palette in tokens.json > ramps (e.g. Palettes::Palettes/Regal Navy is the primary palette).
Run: python tools/recolor.py Reference_Library/Trianglz/Android --ramp <palette> --base <#hex>  (the new key color maps to tone 40).
The script also regenerates every derived token (State Layers/*, Surfaces/Surface Tint *) from its role color and opacity.
Review the contrast report (Light and Dark).
Apply the generated script with figma_execute (same variable names, values only).
Re-export variables and run python tools/build_tokens.py Reference_Library/Trianglz/Android.
Screenshot ➜ Color Palette and every component page in Light and Dark.
never: rename or delete Palette variables during a recolor

contrast_fix.why: M3 keeps on-roles at fixed tones (100 / 10 light, 20 / 90 dark); a failing pair is fixed by moving the role/container tone, not the on-color

alias_fixes.why: alias pointed to another library; M3 baseline dark background = N-10 (no N-6 tone in this file)

manual: Component fixes are in Component_Skills/*/references/gaps.md (e.g. State value "Presssed", "Property 1" on dividers, empty variant property on Snackbar, lowercase false|true on Input chip).
Add space/* spacing variables (none exist) and bind padding/gap.

off_limits.note: Single list of prohibitions. ds-auditor reports each id with a count; hooks enforce the ones marked hook:.

rules.rule: Do not create component-specific tokens (e.g. color/btn/*, button-padding) unless the user asks. Components use Semantic tokens.
rules.check: variable names in Semantic collections must not start with a component name (btn, button, input, card, chip, tab, badge...)
rules.exception: the user explicitly asks for a component token layer

rules.rule: No raw hex outside Primitives and no raw px/pt/dp for padding, gap, radius or font values in components and screens.
rules.check: 0 unbound fills/strokes/padding/gap/radius/text values; tokens.json > recolor_readiness.ready = true

rules.rule: Never edit the original Trianglz template files. Duplicate them and work in the copy.
rules.check: no write operation targets an original file key
rules.exception: the user explicitly asks for a change in the original (e.g. deleting a leftover page)

rules.rule: Never detach an instance. Use instance swaps, slots and exposed properties; if a needed swap is missing, fix the component.
rules.check: 0 detached instances; no detachInstance() in scripts

rules.rule: No default layer or property names: Frame 12, Group 5, Rectangle 3, Vector, Property 1, Variant5, Component 1, trailing ' 2' copies.
rules.check: 0 layers or properties matching the default-name patterns

rules.rule: Foundation documentation pages (colors, typography, spacing, radius, shadows, grid, icons) live only in the ⭐Setup group; component docs sit on their own ➜ page inside their ⭐ group.
rules.check: no foundation doc frame outside ⭐Setup pages

rules.rule: No remote (library) variables, styles or components inside the DS file.
No Mode=Light|Dark variants and no duplicated dark component sets; dark is the Semantic mode on the frame.
rules.check: 0 variant properties named Mode with Light/Dark values

rules.rule: Icons are Material Symbols instances with swap properties; no drawn vectors, text glyphs or empty placeholders.
rules.check: every icon is an instance of the local icon set

rules.rule: Color lives in variables only; no color (paint) styles.
A recolor changes Primitive values only; never rename, delete or recreate Primitives during a recolor.
Never install tools, packages, MCP servers or plugins on the user's behalf; show the steps and let the user do it.
Never push, create a remote repository or publish a Figma library without the user's explicit request.
No absolute machine paths in skills, briefs, data or memory; paths are relative to the Root.
